object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: On a copy of the req-test fixture, open a Document Editor in read-only mode and try each input: write a description into a grid cell; open a grid cell editor; edit in the Inspector; press Tab in the grid; run New sibling; drag an attribute column of the active view to another place; Discard; Undo after an edit; Attach or replace figure and New draw.io figure; the Filters menu's editing entries and Save in the Advanced filter dialog; Validate, on a document with uncommitted changes. Expected: the grid cells aren't editable and a write is refused; the Inspector shows labels, not fields; the outline is unchanged; no object is added; the view file's bytes are unchanged; Discard, Undo, the figure actions and the filter editing entries are disabled; after Validate each work tree file has its earlier content and modified time.
